cleavage_agent.evidence: Proteins were in-gel digested with trypsin and desalted as described in https://doi.org/10.1021/pr500164j.
the enzyme specificity was set to Trypsin/P and two missed cleavages were tolerated.

collision_energy.evidence: A targeted mass exclusion list containing the most prominent peptide m/z ratios for the GST-Af1521 Macro domains was used.
For MS/MS peptides were selected for a 1 s time window in between master scans in a data-dependent mode with HCD at 30% NCE, to be detected in the Orbitrap with a resolution of 30000.

enrichment_method.evidence: The affinity enrichment was performed using the enhanced Af1521 Macro domain versus a G42E mutant variant as control.
The protein fraction was subjected to ADPr-enrichment with the enhanced Af1521 Macro domain (https://doi.org/10.1038/s41467-020-18981-w).

fractionation_method.evidence: Protein samples were separated by 12% SDS-PAGE until the running front had migrated 1 cm into the separating gel.

instrument.evidence: Peptides were analyzed on a Fusion Lumos Tribrid mass spectrometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific).
Eluted peptides were electrosprayed on-line into the Fusion Lumos Tribrid with a spray voltage of 2.0 kV and capillary temperature of 305°C.

labeling.evidence: Proteins were quantified by LFQ as implemented in MaxQuant with default settings.

reduction_concentration.evidence: Protein extracts were prepared by grinding plant leaf material in liquid N2 to a fine powder followed by resuspension in extraction buffer [50 mM Tris-HCl, 150 mM NaCl, 10% (v/v) glycerol, 1 mM EDTA, 5 mM DTT, 1× protease inhibitor cocktail (Sigma-Aldrich #P9599), 10 uM MG132 (Merck), 0.2% NP 40, pH 7.4] at a ratio of 2 mL buffer per 1 g leaf material.
Per affinity purification 15 uL Glutathione-Sepharose 4B resin (Merck) was washed in 50 mM Tris-HCl pH 7.5, 50 mM NaCl, 1 mM DTT and pelleted by centrifugation (500 x g, RT, 1 min).
